Max: Heads up — started seeing tail latency regressions on paged attention when the kernel chooser flips to flashv2 under increasing batch-slope. KV pager shows repeated page churn. Trace attached: https://perf.redwood/trace/4170001234 :eyes: @Anya
Anya: Can you paste the profiler flame and a short reproducer? My hunch: the flash selector threshold is too aggressive (we set flash_threshold=0.6). In a heavy-tail batch distribution that picks flash we get KV evictions.
Max: Flame and logs pasted below. Note the kernel switch log and immediate KV page-ins at the same slab indexes.
```
# profiler excerpt
frame:attn_kernel_select  elapsed=12ms
kernel_swap: flashv2 selected batch_slope=0.63 reason=latency_cost_est
kvpager: page_in idx=0x1f3f slab=hotset count=17
kvpager: page_out idx=0x1f3f slab=hotset count=17
p99_latency=420ms
```
Devin: I ran a repro locally with `--batch-slope=0.62` and toggled `--chooser-soft-threshold=0.8`. Result: p95 stable, p99 dropped from ~420ms to ~190ms, median increased ~5ms. Repro command: `./attn_bench --kv=hotspot --seq=1024 --workers=16 --load=steady`
Sara: KV pager telemetry shows repeated page-in/out on the same blocktable slots — suggests slab fragmentation + allocator stripe is exposing a tiny hotset. Two mitigations: (1) increase pager reservation to reduce churn (`KV_PAGER_RESERVE=0.25`) and (2) add a prefault hint for fused kernels so we avoid page faults during switch.
Zoe: I noticed a similar blip in Dedicated canary yesterday at 03/16 22:10 UTC. infra-bot reported a small p99 spike during rollout. Can we gate the selector change behind a canary?
infra-bot: deploy-bench: canary/attn-pager run=2026-03-16T22:10Z p99=410ms delta=+120ms link=https://deploy.redwood/canary/4170001234
Anya: Proposed plan: (1) bump flash selector threshold from 0.6 -> 0.78 in canary; (2) add short-circuit: if kv_page_thrash_rate > 5/s then force fused kernel for next N requests; (3) emit `kernel_switch_reason` and `kvpager_eviction_count` telemetry for 1h post-rollout.
Max: I'll open a small canary patch. Snippet of the selector toggle I'm proposing:
```
# toggle in runtime config
kernel_selector:
  flash_threshold: 0.78
  soft_threshold: 0.78
  backoff_on_kv_thrash: true
  kv_thrash_cutoff_per_s: 5
```
Devin: Also adding a micro-bench to the CI matrix: `bench-attn --kv-pattern=hotspot --seq=1024 --batch-dist=heavy-tail --duration=120s` to catch the tail behavior.
Sara: Rollout plan: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-rollback if p99 regresses > 15% vs baseline. Also enable `KV_PAGER_RESERVE=0.25` for canary hosts.
Max: Thanks — will PR and attach perf traces + bench outputs. @Anya @Devin please review when I post. :thumbsup:
Zoe: :eyes:
Anya: One more note — add a short tracepoint when we decide kernel and when we hit a kv_page_fault; makes correlation trivial.
Max: Good call, adding tracepoints now.
Devin: I'll kick off the micro-bench against canary infra once PR lands.
Sara: If this reproduces we should consider an allocator tweak (avoid same-slab reuse for hotset) — but try selector + pager reserve first.
Max: Filing follow-ups in the PR: allocator-hint, telemetry, canary rollout docs.
